results.reply:
Yeh sunkar bahut bura laga ki aapko itni pareshani ho rahi hai. Ghaziabad mein labour laws ke mutabik, agar thekedar gayab hai, toh factory management ki zimmedari banti hai ki woh aapka baki paisa dilwaye. Aap akele nahi hain, kanoon mein iska rasta hai.

Kya aapke paas factory ka koi ID card, gate pass, ya attendance ka proof hai? Kya aapne factory ke manager ko abhi tak koi written complaint di hai?

Yeh rahe aapke options:
1. Factory management ko formal letter/email likhein (unhe yaad dilayein ki thekedar unke premises par tha).
2. Ghaziabad ke Labour Office mein 'Inspector-cum-Facilitator' se milein.
3. SAMADHAN portal (samadhan.labour.gov.in) par online complaint darj karein.

Sabse pehle, aapko factory management ko ek written notice dena chahiye jisme saaf likha ho ki kitne mahine ka paisa baki hai. Kya main aapke liye yeh letter draft karun?

citations.title: Who is an 'employee' (includes managerial and supervisory staff)
citations.plain: Under the Code on Wages, 'employee' covers anyone an establishment employs on wages for skilled, unskilled, manual, clerical, technical, supervisory, managerial or administrative work. Managers and senior staff therefore count as employees. Apprentices and members of the Armed Forces do not.

citations.title: Filing a wage claim: who decides it and the 3-year limit
citations.plain: Wage claims under the Code are heard by an authority the Government appoints, who must be at least a Gazetted Officer. The claim can be filed by you, your registered trade union, or an Inspector-cum-Facilitator. File within 3 years of the date the claim arises; a later claim may still be accepted if you show sufficient cause. Besides the amount due, the authority can award compensation of up to ten times the claim, and it tries to decide within three months.

citations.title: SAMADHAN: online portal for labour disputes and claims (central sphere)
citations.plain: SAMADHAN (https://samadhan.labour.gov.in) is the labour ministry's online portal for raising industrial disputes and, since its 2.0 upgrade, filing claims under the Labour Codes and tracking them. It is run by the Chief Labour Commissioner (Central) machinery, so it mainly serves establishments where the Central Government is the appropriate Government. For most private employers, the state labour department is the forum.
